item.title: On the Quiet Return of the Feed Reader
item.dc:creator: Ada Wexler
item.description: For a decade we let algorithms decide what we saw. A small, stubborn corner of the web kept publishing feeds anyway.
item.content:encoded:
For a decade we let algorithms decide what we saw. A small, stubborn corner of the web kept publishing feeds anyway.

What changed

Nothing about the format. Everything about our patience.

The reader is not a product. It is a habit.
